_comment: D.A Maqam Analyzer - Maqam database JSON mirror for documentation/export. Real authoritative source is C++ curated entries in MaqamDatabase.cpp. This JSON is for tooling and is not loaded at runtime unless explicitly requested.
provenance: Curated from Boroumand radif, Farhat 2004, During, Marcus 'Music in Egypt' 2007, Signell 'Makam' 1977, Arel-Ezgi-Uzdilek theory, Mammadov 2013, Farraj & Shumays, UNESCO Mugham docs. Intervals are theoretical references - real performance intonation varies. See C++ source for per-entry citations and verification status.

Persian: Shur (Dastgah) with avaz Abu Ata, Bayat-e Tork, Afshari, Dashti

note: All entries are tradition-specific and not interchangeable. Turkish 53-TET koma system (~22c per koma) approximated in cents; Arabic 24-TET quarter-tone is theoretical ~50c approx; Persian koron ~ -50c and sori ~ +50c are performer-variable. Do not reduce to fixed 12-TET.
